ينحسم (form VII)
# يَنْحَسِمُ (yanḥasimu) /jan.ħa.si.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْحَسَمَ (inḥasama)
# يَنْحَسِمَ (yanḥasima) /jan.ħa.si.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَسَمَ (inḥasama)
# يَنْحَسِمْ (yanḥasim) /jan.ħa.sim/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْحَسَمَ (inḥasama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
